caption: The drawing features a single transparent glass object placed against a plain, light beige background. The object is composed of a long, curved tube that bends near the bottom left corner and extends upward and to the right. At the upper right section, the tube splits into a looped segment that forms a large loop, then curves around and attaches to a bulbous, teardrop-shaped chamber with a slightly flared, ridged end. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray and white, with shading used to give the object a three-dimensional, reflective appearance, indicating its glassy material. There are no other objects or distinct markings in the composition.
title: Jersey Pipe
